dessin: A government contract document seen flat from the front: one portrait sheet of paper, flat pale #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline. At the top of the sheet, a title band about one fifth of the sheet height, closed below by a double horizontal ink rule (two thin parallel lines close together) running across the full width; the title band is completely empty. Below the double rule, the body of the sheet is completely empty pale paper: no lines, no bars, no text, no seal, no signature, no stamp. Nothing else.
